The all-funds budget-vs-actual schedule (p14) is by function and mixes funds, so only its four separable utility lines (Electric, Waste, Wastewater, Water; actual and final budget, business-type, expenditure) are recorded in detail (no detail_total: the schedule prints no total for these lines alone, only the all-funds total 14,275,790.28); its governmental function lines (which combine the General Fund with Debt Service, LB840 and CDBG, funds without their own detail schedule) and its revenue lines (not split by fund) are left out to avoid double counting the General Fund detail. The utility lines are budget-basis, not the GAAP proprietary statement figures on p10. General Fund budget_final left null (no budget column on pp15-20).
